description: Use before onboarding, paying or contracting a European company: finds it in 10 official registers (GLEIF, UK, IE, FR, NO, FI, CZ, SK, EE, PL), screens it and its directors and owners (UK, FR, NO) against EU, UN, UK and US sanctions and PEP, checks the VAT number, flags new websites and Dutch bankruptcies. One verdict: pass, review, block_review or incomplete. Input: name or id, best with country; optional vat, domain, kvk. Costs 0.05 USDC via x402, or 25 credits of a Factline API key.

country.description: ISO country, e.g. NL, GB, IE, FR

id.description: Or a company number: LEI, UK company number, Irish CRO, SIREN, etc.

kvk.description: Dutch KvK number: adds a bankruptcy check

vat.description: EU VAT number: checked in VIES and matched to the registered name

name: eu_company_check
title: One-call European company check (paid)
